items.headline: DeShields has 3 TDs, defense dominates second half, Kent State tops Wofford 36-15
items.description: — Dru DeShields threw for a touchdown and ran for two more scores, and Kent State dominated the second half for a 36-15 win over FCS Wofford on Saturday.

items.headline: LaNorris Sellers embraces Gamecocks' fast-paced offense
items.description: Following South Carolina's 57-0 shutout of Kent State, Sellers says OC Kendal Briles has brought an energetic, up-tempo style to the offense.

items.headline: LaNorris Sellers throws for 3 TDs as South Carolina whipped Kent State 57-0 to begin season
items.description: — LaNorris Sellers threw three touchdown passes among five TD drives as South Carolina whipped Kent State 57-0 on Saturday in the season-opener for each team.
